rec.name: Product Image Slider with Progress-Bar / Dot Indicator
rec.status: Built — approved by PM 2025-11-14, cleared to merge into live theme

what.text: A swipeable product image slider with a minimal position indicator. On collection product cards (desktop and mobile) a thin black progress bar sits under each image, with the bar length reflecting how many images the product has. On the mobile PDP, the bar is replaced by subtle dots (active dot black, inactive dots light grey) in the style of the LFDY reference. Desktop was approved with the LFDY-style layout.

why.text: A visible position indicator signals that more images exist and shows where the shopper is in the set, which encourages swiping and exploring (more product visuals reduce uncertainty). Minimal indicators keep the product imagery clean and premium for a fashion brand. On the PDP, dots are a familiar mobile pattern and are less visually heavy than a bar sitting under the hero image.

how.text: Build the product card/PDP media as a scroll-snap or Swiper-type slider. Render a progress-bar indicator on collection cards and desktop, with the thumb width set to 100% divided by the number of slides and its position following scroll progress. On the mobile PDP template, switch the indicator to circle dots: the active dot is black and the others light grey, centred at the bottom of the image. The ticket's reference for the dots is the LFDY PDP.

items: Indicator style: progress bar vs. circle dots (bar on collection and desktop, dots on mobile PDP)
Indicator colours: active black, inactive light grey
Indicator position: bottom of the image, left-aligned bar or centred dots
Show/hide indicator when a product has only one image

dependencies.text: Products need multiple images. Theme needs a slider/carousel component, and the indicator style must be switchable per template (PDP mobile vs. collection/desktop). The ticket doesn't mention apps or metafields. No details of the Liquid or JS implementation are given.

items: Mobile bounce rate on collection and PDP
